result.description:
About Us
Broome Aviation Group has been operating in the Kimberley for over 40 years, providing charter and scenic flights throughout the Kimberley and Pilbara. We are a well-established, family-owned business looking for an experienced and practical Corporate Services Manager to join our management team.

About the Role
This is a varied, hands-on role that supports the day-to-day running of the business. Working closely with the Managing Director and Financial Controller, you will oversee administration, payroll, office operations and business support while assisting with finance, staffing and marketing activities.

The role is busier during the dry season when flight operations increase and more administration-focused during the wet season, so flexibility and the ability to manage changing priorities are important.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the day-to-day administration of the office.
Lead and provide hands-on support to the administration, accounts and operations team.
Manage and complete the end to end payroll function, employee records and onboarding.
Assist with accounts payable, receivable and reconciliations.
Support charter and tour administration.
Coordinate recruitment and general HR administration.
Assist with marketing, social media and promotional activities.
Prepare reports and maintain business records.
Assist with compliance, insurance, tenders and lease administration.
Support business development activities by representing the business professionally, building local relationships and assisting with revenue growth initiatives
Provide general operational and administrative support across the business.

About You
You will be organised, reliable and enjoy working in a busy environment where every day is different.
You'll ideally have:
Experience in office management, administration or business support.
Payroll and MYOB experience.
Strong organisational and communication skills.
Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
The ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Able to manage staff and priorities in a busy environment.
A positive, flexible and hands-on approach.

Experience in aviation, tourism or a small business environment will be highly regarded but is not essential.

Location: 		Salisbury, QLD, 4107
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to: 		Manager
Job Title: 		Electrical Engineering Technician
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 Days

Position Overview: Mygration is engaged to source the following position for our client
Our client is a leading innovator in the design, fabrication, and installation of high-quality steel structures and electrical systems for industrial and commercial applications. With a strong focus on engineering excellence, safety, and precision, they deliver cutting-edge solutions across various sectors, including infrastructure, energy, and manufacturing.

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineering Technician to join their dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting the design, installation, and maintenance of electrical systems for heavy machinery, substations, and industrial control systems. You will work closely with engineers and technologists to ensure all electrical installations meet industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical skills and a passion for electrical systems within an industrial and structural engineering environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design & Documentation:
• Prepare detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and layout plans for industrial installations, including substations, switchgear, motor control systems, and cabling networks.
• Develop wiring diagrams and termination schedules for control panels used in heavy machinery & manufacturing and automation systems.

Technical Support:
• Assist electrical engineers in the design, testing, and optimization of electrical systems for machinery & manufacturing and structural projects.
• Troubleshoot and diagnose faults in PLC-controlled systems, including servo drives and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

Testing & Analysis:
• Conduct electrical tests, perform complex calculations, and analyse data to validate system performance.
• Perform insulation resistance (IR) testing, earth continuity checks, and thermal imaging on high-voltage equipment.

Cost Estimation:
• Assist in estimating material quantities, costs, and project timelines.
• Evaluate supplier quotations for electrical components (e.g., circuit breakers, contactors) to ensure cost-effective procurement.

Quality Assurance:
• Inspect electrical installations and finished products for compliance with specifications.
• Verify that all electrical work adheres to AS/NZS 3000 and IEC standards before commissioning.

Installation & Maintenance:
• Assemble, install, calibrate, and repair electrical equipment, including protection relays and metering devices.
• Perform preventive maintenance on industrial motor control centres (MCCs) to minimize downtime.

Workshop Operations:
• Undertake workshop duties, including wiring, testing, and modifying electrical assemblies.
• Fabricate and test custom control panels for machinery integration.

Research & Development:
• Contribute to R&D initiatives by assisting in experimental programs.
• Assist in the testing and integration of renewable energy systems (e.g., solar inverters) into industrial power networks.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:
• Trade Certification or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
• Proven experience in electrical drafting, machinery wiring, or industrial electrical systems and manufacturing fabrications.
• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical) for schematic and layout design.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform technical calculations and interpret test data.
• Knowledge of industry standards, including AS/NZS 3000 and electrical safety regulations.
• Hands-on experience with motor controls, switchgear, PLCs, and protection systems is highly desirable.
• Workshop & fabrication skills, including the ability to assemble and troubleshoot electrical components.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and project teams.
• At least 2 years of Full-time on the job work experience.

WHY APPLY?
• Work with a forward-thinking company at the forefront of industrial and structural engineering.
• Engage in high-impact projects involving cutting-edge electrical systems.
• Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
• Competitive remuneration and a supportive team environment.

If you are a motivated Electrical Engineering Technician with a passion for precision and innovation, we encourage you to apply! Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Please note: We are recruiting on behalf of our client. All applications will be treated with confidentiality.

Join a high-performing engineering team delivering complex, cutting-edge defence programmes  Melbourne CBD | 12-Month Contract | Highly Attractive Daily Rates An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Project Engineer to join a leading global defence organisation supporting a significant land systems program. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will play a key role in the delivery of complex capability projects from concept through to production and integration. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys balancing technical design responsibilities with project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and engineering governance.     Your new role     As Project Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of engineering activities across a complex defence program. You will work closely with design, systems, manufacturing and project management teams to ensure technical outcomes are delivered on time, within budget and to the required standards. A key part of this role will involve the development and management of engineering designs and documentation using Creo CAD and associated product lifecycle management tools.   Key Responsibilities  
 
 Coordinate engineering activities across the project lifecycle. 
 Support project planning, scheduling and technical risk management. 
 Develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies and engineering documentation. 
 Create and maintain 3D CAD models and technical drawings using Creo. 
 Manage engineering change processes and design modifications. 
 Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are achieved. 
 Support design reviews, verification and validation activities. 
 Ensure compliance with defence, quality and engineering standards. 
 Collaborate with manufacturing and production teams to support successful delivery outcomes. 
 
  What you'll need to succeed

The Product & Quality Department Manager is responsible for planning, directing and coordinating systems that ensure the restaurant consistently delivers high-quality products while maintaining strict food safety, operational compliance and inventory management standards.

The role oversees production systems, food safety procedures, inventory management and operational quality assurance within a high-volume quick-service restaurant environment operating on a 24-hour basis.

Operating within a franchised hospitality environment, the position ensures that all food preparation, storage and production processes comply with organisational standards and regulatory requirements while supporting operational efficiency and product consistency.

This is a managerial role responsible for coordinating operational quality systems, production processes and compliance programs, rather than performing routine kitchen supervision duties.


Key Responsibilities

Product Quality and Food Safety Management

• Develop and implement operational procedures that ensure consistent product quality in accordance with organisational standards.

• Coordinate food safety management systems and ensure compliance with food safety regulations and company policies.

• Conduct regular audits of food preparation processes to ensure operational procedures and hygiene standards are maintained.

• Monitor product quality indicators and implement corrective actions where quality standards are not met.

• Ensure all food handling, preparation and storage procedures comply with regulatory food safety requirements.


Production and Operational Systems Management

• Coordinate restaurant production systems to ensure efficient food preparation and service delivery.

• Analyse production performance and develop and implement operational and business improvement strategies to maximise efficiency, reduce waste and enhance product quality

• Develop procedures that ensure consistent product preparation across operational departments.

• Monitor operational systems to ensure production capacity meets customer demand during peak service periods.


Inventory and Supply Chain Management

• Manage inventory control systems including stock rotation, ordering procedures and stock level monitoring.

• Conduct regular stock audits and analyse stock usage patterns to support waste reduction initiatives.

• Coordinate inventory ordering schedules and supplier delivery planning.

• Ensure storage procedures comply with FIFO stock rotation systems and food safety standards.


Equipment and Facilities Oversight

• Develop preventative maintenance schedules for food preparation equipment and kitchen infrastructure.

• Conduct regular operational audits of equipment performance and operational readiness.

• Coordinate equipment maintenance and repair activities with external contractors and service providers.

• Monitor equipment calibration systems to ensure accurate food preparation processes.


Operational Compliance and Risk Management

• Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety policies related to food production and kitchen operations.

• Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments across production and food handling areas.

• Implement corrective actions to address operational compliance issues.


Staff Training and Operational Standards

• Design and implement training programs to ensure employees maintain food safety and product preparation standards.

• Provide operational guidance to staff to ensure consistency in food preparation and product presentation.

• Support the development of staff capability in food production systems and quality management procedures.

• Direct, supervise and coordinate staff involved in food production, quality control and operational systems  

• Monitor individual and team performance and implement performance improvement strategies  

• Conduct staff performance evaluations and support workforce planning activities  


Operational Reporting and Continuous Improvement

• Monitor operational quality metrics and prepare reports for senior management.

• Analyse operational performance data and identify opportunities to improve product quality and operational efficiency.

• Support the Restaurant Manager and Licensee in implementing operational improvement initiatives.


Qualification and Experience Requirements

The position requires:

• AQF Diploma and minimum one year of relevant work experience or at least three years of experience if no formal qualifications.

OR

• A minimum of three (3) years of relevant managerial experience within a franchised hospitality or quick-service restaurant environment, demonstrating responsibility for operational management, product quality systems and business performance.

JBS Australia is Australia's largest and most respected meat and food processing company, employing thousands of people across the country. We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced IT Coordinator to join our team at JBS Dinmore.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about developing people, driving performance, and creating a strong culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

About the Role
As an IT Coordinator at Dinmore Plant, you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting all plant IT systems to ensure operational efficiency. This role includes installing and configuring hardware and software, performing preventative maintenance, and troubleshooting technical issues. The position requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication with non-technical users, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment. The IT Coordinator plays a key role in minimising downtime, supporting continuous improvement, and ensuring reliable technology performance across the site. This is a full-time role with annual salary not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

Your key responsibilities include:
Perform preventative and scheduled maintenance on all plant IT assets to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Install and configure new hardware, including desktop computers and industrial printers, to support operational needs.
Deploy and configure software across multiple platforms, ensuring compatibility and functionality.
Modify, configure and customise existing software applications and system settings to meet operational requirements and improve user functionality and efficiency.
Assess software and hardware requirements and recommend appropriate technical solutions to meet operational and user needs across the plant environment.
Configure, implement and maintain local computer networks and connectivity solutions to support business systems and operational equipment.
Assist with the design, maintenance and updating of internal web-based platforms, intranet resources or business websites to support operational and communication requirements.
Monitor, diagnose, and resolve daily IT issues throughout the plant, providing timely and effective support.
Troubleshoot and resolve user-related problems as they arise, minimising downtime and disruption.
Escalate complex issues to the broader IT support team while maintaining accountability for resolution and closure.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth IT operations.
Prepare reports and track data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus 1 year of full-time relevant experience. Alternatively, at least 3 years of relevant experience and/or relevant vendor certification may substitute for the formal qualifications.
Previous experience working with varied IT hardware, software, and operating systems.
Ability to work autonomously as well as part of a greater team.
Highly developed interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills – with the ability to explain technical issues to a non-technical user base.
Highly developed time management skills, including prioritising tasks and meeting conflicting deadlines.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
High standard of computer literacy.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and diagnostic skills.
Previous experience in a food manufacturing/processing environment would be preferable.

What We Offer
Career development opportunities within a global organisation
Supportive leadership team and collaborative work environment
Access to employee benefits and wellbeing programs
Opportunity to make a genuine impact on workforce capability and employee success
Long-term career opportunities with one of Australia's leading employers
If you are passionate about developing people and want to be part of a business that values safety, teamwork and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.
